# (Recogniser.render, recognisePage, fittedToGutters on a plain render, as score-page-kind; an image wrapped as makeSearchablePDF wraps it).
# Sets: truth = Archive Suite's OCR truth set (HW-PAGES-2026-10-15.tsv; label its kind), held-out = 15 Handwritten-tagged photos (HW-PAGES),
# photo = the photographed sample (PK-PHOTO-SAMPLE-2026-10-14.tsv: its form tag, the four handwriting photos labelled handwritten; an id ending x is
# the EXIF-stripped copy; pdf pages as PK-PHOTO-DETECT-2026-10-14.tsv), page-kind = PAGE-KIND-2026-10-12.tsv's 152 pages (label its route or item type).
# Signals (Recogniser.HandSignals): lines with four marks or more, letters a mark, foot step off the fitted line, residual off it, joined share.
# Called handwritten: truth 18 of 19 handwritten (p048, a letter photographed beside a typed sheet whose lines are half the page's, missed) and 1 of 2 mixed
# (p009, a typed page with handwritten notes, is not); held-out 14 of 15 (hw04, one line of letters among handwritten figures, missed); photo 8 of 8
# handwriting rows (pk20 and its stripped copy, a blank sheet, are not); no typed, printed, notes, clipping, statistics or PDF page of any set (79 + 55 + 152 pages).
# Not measured: the rebuilt bitmaps the app reads on the rebuild route (often 1-bit).
